overview_description.description:
Introducing SmartHelio - the revolutionary software that helps solar companies detect and identify faults quickly, enabling them to gain a significant performance boost of up to 3%!

Our software uses advanced algorithms and data analysis to pinpoint issues within a solar system, providing real-time insights and recommendations for immediate action. This allows solar companies to quickly and easily resolve any issues, improving the overall performance and efficiency of their solar systems.

In today's competitive market, every percentage point counts. With SmartHelio, you can gain a significant advantage over your competitors and increase your revenue potential. Our software is easy to use and requires minimal training, making it the perfect solution for solar companies of all sizes.
SmartHelio provide a dashboard or fully integrate into the existing customers’ IT platform. SmartHelio is deploying AI on Edge devices to reduce the cost of data collection, storage,  and processing without compromising the quality of analytics services. This empower energy developers and managers to maintain their assets consistently at a high-performance level with minimum human intervention. SmartHelio is able to generate 5% extra energy and optimize 30% of O&M effort.

about_short_description.short_description: SmartHelio is software to prevent downtime in a solar plant

product.name: Autopilot
product.description: A unified solar efficiency platform that collects, processes, and analyzes solar plant data to predict faults, localize failures, and provide actionable insights for operational and financial management.

product.name: One-Time Diagnostics (AI-driven Audit)
product.description: A diagnostic tool that analyzes solar plant data to identify current and future faults, uncover hidden losses, and generate detailed health reports for performance optimization and risk assessment.

product.name: SolarGPT
product.description: An interactive reporting tool powered by ChatGPT that provides fast, customizable answers and reports about solar plant health, faults, and operational performance.

product.name: Climate Risk Assessment
product.description: A forecasting tool that predicts long-term solar irradiance (GHI) based on climate change and over 100 variables to support investment and project planning.

product.name: Fast Diagnostic Tool
product.description: A quick analysis tool that provides detailed performance insights and fault detection within 10 seconds by uploading solar plant AC data.

product.name: Data-Driven Soiling Management
product.description: A software method that uses inverter data and environmental inputs to detect soiling losses and optimize cleaning schedules without additional hardware.
